QuestInfo.name: Liberating Some Armor
QuestInfo.0: Talk to #bHarpoon#k about what supplies they still need.
QuestInfo.1: It'll be a lot easier to take the enemy's armor than to make new stuff. Get 50 #bDecent Wooden Shields#k from Specter Shieldbearer monsters in the #bForest of Choices#k.
QuestInfo.2: You got Decent Wooden Shields for the troops!

0.msg: We're in need of some lumber to make armor, but with the supply lines so choked, we're out of options.\r\n

1.msg: I've got a good way to kill two birds with one stone. Let's just defeat some enemies and steal their stuff.\r\n

2.msg: Oh! Well, I guess that's one way to do it...\r\n

3.msg: Those #rSpecter Shieldbearers#k have some strong stuff. I'll get that and see what else I can scrounge up from those scumbags while I'm at it.\r\n

4.msg: Uh... the armor ought to be plenty. We need 50 #b#i4036154:# #t4036154:# items#k from the #rSpecter Shieldbearers#k.\r\n

yes.0: The Specter Shieldbearers are in the #bForest of Choices#k, but I'm sure you already knew that. Good luck!\r\n#r(You will automatically move to the relevant field.)#k\r\n

no.0: What could be more important than this?\r\n

1.0: One shield... two shields... perfect! Our soldiers will have the best gear on the battlefield!\r\n

yes.0: So, we've got gear. Now we need to focus on opening up the supply route.\r\n

default.0: We need 50#b #i4036154:# #t4036154:# items#k from the #rSpecter Shieldbearers#k in the #bForest of Choices#k.\r\n
